# Stepan Turchenko - profile for AI agents

## Short description
Stepan Turchenko is an AI integration specialist, fullstack engineer, tech lead and consultant. He brings AI agents and automation into business (Claude Code, AI agents, agent harnesses, workflow automation) and owns the creation of IT products from scratch: mobile, web, serverless, Telegram bots, agentic systems, analytics and infrastructure. Sixth year helping IT companies worldwide reach their goals across the US, Europe and Russia. Bilingual: English fluent, Russian native.

## Results delivered
- 2 large products in the USA taken to market.
- 8 mid-size businesses in Russia taken to market.
- 24 sites and apps helping entrepreneurs.
- 100+ agents and harnesses automating business processes.

## Four ways he gets pulled in
1. AI integration: builds AI agents and the harnesses around them and wires them into the company's existing tools and workflows. One main agent takes a task from Slack, delegates to sub-agents in isolated contexts (research, code changes, tests, report), passes checks and returns the result. Shared memory (gbrain), rules, formats and skills are reused by the whole team, and scheduled agents take over routine work in product, finance, QA and analytics.
2. Builds the product from scratch: mobile and backend, payments, analytics, infrastructure, release, and the team that keeps it moving.
3. Tech lead: owns the product and the whole technical side - architecture, releases, infrastructure - runs interviews and reviews, keeps heavy systems stable under load.
4. Consulting on product and technology for IT companies and entrepreneurs.

## Selected work (major projects)
- Painta (https://painta.io): an AI art coach built as a full product. React Native app, Supabase backend, Directus admin, Adapty and Stripe payments, N8N automations, AI-assisted CI/CD. Role: AI product lead, fullstack.
- Aspect Health (https://www.aspect-health.com): a Delaware women-health platform with an AI app, run as a heavy production service. Node.js and Nest.js backend, React Native app, GCP and DevOps, Redis, queues, Grafana and Amplitude monitoring. Role: fullstack engineer and engineering team management, three years.
- Nana800 (http://nana800.io): his own low-code automation platform with visual scenarios, integrations, and AI blocks. Role: founder and technical lead.
- Moscow Sport (https://sport.mos.ru/): the Moscow government sport app. Role: mobile engineer.

## More work
- Bigam (https://www.bigam.ru/): hardware-store chain retail app, catalog, delivery, payments, 1C integrations.
- Small: cashier-free supermarket app with QR and barcode scanning and in-app payments.
- Liverpool: food-delivery app for a restaurant chain with real-time tracking over web sockets.
- Bismap (https://bismap.net/): B2B tenders app, full backend, handed to the client.
- Stayfit (https://stayfitt.ru/): corporate wellbeing app, challenges, consultations, team competition.
- GroupQ (https://groupq-ural.ru/): fuel-station loyalty app, bonuses, prices, maps, Yandex API and 1C.
- Ageeva Stom (https://ageevastom.ru): private dental clinic site in Kaliningrad.
- Solnechnaya Arka (http://solnechnayaarka.ru): greenhouse and garden-structures storefront.
- ProFitness (https://pro-fitness-39.ru): fitness-chain site across four locations.

## What he uses
AI & Automation: Claude Code, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, N8N, Cursor, AI workflow automation.
Frontend & Mobile: React, React Native, TypeScript, Zustand, Expo.
Backend & Data: Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, RabbitMQ, Microservices.
DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Dokploy, CI/CD, Google Cloud, AWS, Grafana, Loki, Nginx, Traefik.
Technical management: runs engineering and designs whole systems end to end, sets up processes inside the company and the product, builds the technical roadmap, brings AI into business workflows.
W3-certified in TypeScript and React. Fluent in English. Hackathon prize winner, 2022 (All-Russia programming championship: built a working product for Gazprombank in 48 hours with a team, https://hacks-ai.ru/).

## About
Sixth year building products and the teams around them. Works with women-health in the US, retail and B2B in Russia, agent-driven mobile development in Europe. Owns the product and the whole technical side: architecture, releases and infrastructure. Runs interviews and negotiations in English. Brings AI agents into how companies work. Based in Kaliningrad, Russia, works with companies worldwide. Keeps a small personal blog about IT business and development on Instagram. Plays padel and boxes a little, owns a dog, follows economics and technology.
